text:
॥ Om, for the establishment of the desired qualities, Om ॥ 1/2/2 ॥

“Sa yo’to’ashrutah” and so on. Indeed, He possesses the quality of being unheard of, as stated in “Na te Vishno jayamanah” and so on. Furthermore, in the Chaturveda Shikha, it is stated: “He is Savita, He is Vayu, He is Indra, He is the Unheard, He is the Unseen, He is Hari, He is the Supreme, He is Vishnu, He is the Infinite.”
